BiblicalUsage: Joshaviah is named once, in 1 Chronicles 11:46. In 1 Chronicles 11:46 we read, "Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,".
TheologicalSignificance: Joshaviah is a name the Bible did not forget, and I believe God forgets no one.
